title: fix(deploy): escape rule group names in the provisioning URL

files.patch:
@@ -63,7 +63,7 @@ These settings control the alert rules the integrate stage builds, and how it te
 | `query_model`          | string  | None       | Custom query model, as a `fmt.Sprintf` format string. Overrides the built-in model. Refer to [Use a custom query model](data-sources.md#use-a-custom-query-model).                                 |
 | `folder_id`            | string  | None       | UID of the Grafana folder the alert rules go in. Every configuration must resolve a value, here or in `defaults`.                                                                                  |
 | `org_id`               | integer | None       | ID of the Grafana organization. Every configuration must resolve a value, here or in `defaults`.                                                                                                   |
-| `rule_group`           | string  | `Default`  | Name of the alert rule group in Grafana.                                                                                                                                                            |
+| `rule_group`           | string  | `Default`  | Name of the alert rule group in Grafana. Spaces and characters such as `?`, `#`, and `%` are escaped in the provisioning URL. A `/` is escaped as `%2F`; Grafana may not accept it in the name. |
 | `time_window`          | duration | `5m`       | How far back each query looks, and how often the rule group is evaluated. |
 | `lookback`             | duration | `0s`      | Shifts the query time range back by this amount, to allow for ingestion delay. For example, a `5m` window with a `1m` lookback queries from 6 minutes ago to 1 minute ago.                         |
 | `test_queries`         | boolean | `false`    | Run each query against the data source and report the results on the pull request.                                                                                                                  |

@@ -6,6 +6,7 @@ import (
 	"fmt"
 	"log"
 	"net/http"
+	"net/url"

@@ -893,7 +894,10 @@ func (d *Deployer) updateAlert(ctx context.Context, content string, createIfNotF
 
 func (d *Deployer) updateAlertGroupInterval(ctx context.Context, folderUID string, group string, interval int64) error {
 	log.Printf("Checking alert group interval for %s/%s to %d", folderUID, group, interval)
-	path := fmt.Sprintf("api/v1/provisioning/folder/%s/rule-groups/%s", folderUID, group)
+	// Both values are one path segment. A raw "?", "#", "%" or "/" in a rule
+	// group name is parsed as part of the URL, so the request fails or hits
+	// a different group.
+	path := fmt.Sprintf("api/v1/provisioning/folder/%s/rule-groups/%s", url.PathEscape(folderUID), url.PathEscape(group))
 
 	// Get the current alert group content
 	res, err := d.client.Get(ctx, path)
